mapper.select: SELECT r.*, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT ts.source_id) FROM zentide_topic_link rt JOIN zentide_topic_link ts ON ts.topic_id=rt.topic_id AND ts.source_id IS NOT NULL AND ts.status='ACTIVE' WHERE rt.radar_id=r.radar_id) AS source_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT tc.change_id) FROM zentide_topic_link rt JOIN zentide_topic_link tc ON tc.topic_id=rt.topic_id AND tc.change_id IS NOT NULL JOIN zentide_change c ON c.change_id=tc.change_id WHERE rt.radar_id=r.radar_id AND c.status='PUBLISHED' AND c.verification_status='VERIFIED') AS change_count FROM zentide_radar r WHERE r.owner_id=#{ownerId} AND r.status!='ARCHIVED' ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC
SELECT * FROM zentide_radar WHERE radar_id=#{radarId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM zentide_topic WHERE topic_id=#{topicId} AND status='ACTIVE' LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE zentide_radar SET name=#{name},attention_level=#{attentionLevel},notification_strategy=#{notificationStrategy}, change_types_json=#{changeTypesJson},source_preferences_json=#{sourcePreferencesJson}, ignore_rules_json=#{ignoreRulesJson},user_context=#{userContext},version=version+1, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE radar_id=#{radarId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status!='ARCHIVED'
UPDATE zentide_radar SET version=version+1,updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE radar_id=#{radarId} AND owner_id=#{ownerId} AND status='ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zentide_topic(canonical_name,topic_type,status) VALUES(#{canonicalName},#{topicType},'ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE topic_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(topic_id)
INSERT INTO zentide_topic_link(radar_id,topic_id,weight,include_descendants,note) VALUES(#{radarId},#{topicId},1.00,1,#{note}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE note=VALUES(note)

INSERT INTO zentide_user_action(user_id,topic_id,action_type,action_value,status) VALUES(#{userId},#{topicId},'FOLLOW','DAILY','ACTIVE') ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='ACTIVE',updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
mapper.select: SELECT rt.topic_link_id AS radar_topic_id,rt.radar_id,rt.topic_id,rt.weight,rt.include_descendants,rt.note,t.canonical_name,t.topic_type FROM zentide_topic_link rt JOIN zentide_topic t ON t.topic_id=rt.topic_id WHERE rt.radar_id=#{radarId} ORDER BY t.canonical_name
